name: aud001-evidence-sha256sums-check
command:
cd docs/audits/AUD-001-evidence && sha256sum -c SHA256SUMS 2>/dev/null | grep -v ': OK$'; echo "entries=$(wc -l < SHA256SUMS) failed=$(sha256sum -c SHA256SUMS 2>/dev/null | grep -vc ': OK$')"; echo '--- command companions whose log hash still matches:'; python3 - <<'PY'
import json,glob,hashlib,os
ok=bad=0
for c in sorted(glob.glob('*.command.json')):
    d=json.load(open(c)); log=d.get('log') or c.replace('.command.json','.log')
    exp=next((v for k,v in d.items() if 'sha' in k.lower() and isinstance(v,str) and len(v)==64),None)
    if exp and os.path.exists(log): 
        if hashlib.sha256(open(log,'rb').read()).hexdigest()==exp: ok+=1
        else: bad+=1; print('mismatch',c)
print('log hashes ok',ok,'bad',bad)
PY
